# User Mobility Subscription Output Schema

The output must be a JSON object with the following root structure:

{
"user_mobility_subscriptions": [
{
"subscription_id": "string | UUID | optional if generated by the application",
"user_id": "string",

```
  "subscription_category": "public_transport | bike_sharing | car_sharing | e_scooter",
  "provider_name": "string",
  "provider_plan_name": "string | null",

  "subscription_type": "subscription | membership | pay_as_you_go_account | trial | employer_benefit | student_benefit",
  "subscription_status": "active | inactive | paused | cancelled | expired",

  "valid_from": "YYYY-MM-DD | null",
  "valid_until": "YYYY-MM-DD | null",

  "billing_cycle": "monthly | yearly | pay_as_you_go | one_time | none | null",
  "monthly_cost_eur": "number | null",

  "is_primary_mobility_option": "boolean",
  "usage_frequency": "daily | several_times_per_week | weekly | several_times_per_month | rarely | unknown",

  "created_from_persona": "string | null",
  "generation_rationale": "string | null"
}
```

]
}

## Important Notes

If a stricter runtime schema is provided, the stricter runtime schema overrides this Markdown schema.

Do not generate fields that are not part of the active schema.

Do not omit required fields from the active schema.

Use `null` only for optional fields where no plausible value can be inferred.

`user_id` must match a user from the provided input user profiles.
